text_block_list.text:
One day after school.
Heavy rain began to pour, as if the clear afternoon sky had been a lie.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, it's pouring rain.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: No waay~?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And I was supposed to eat a ton of
marvelous ice cream sundaes today too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft!
That's so dumb—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What's up?
Did I do something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... nope, not at all. It's just my own business, so don't worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, look! Trainer said
they'd teach us something even more fun than ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Really!?
Tell me, tell me!
choice_data_list: ...A game we can all play together?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A game?
Like that's gonna just be lying around—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah.

What Nice Nature placed on the floor
were cardboard menko cards.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's an old-fashioned game,
so I don't know if it'll be to your liking, but..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What's this, what's this☆
I've never seen this before, simply marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, ah, to be young.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"These are called Menko.
You slam the card in your hand onto the floor and—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! It flipped over!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just like this,
you flip the menko on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Very, very marvelous☆
It'll be even more fun if we invite everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait—?!
...Ah, there she goes.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Is this a Menko hood?
It looks just like a badge, so cute~âª

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
They even have Carrotman patterns!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
Everyone has one now, so shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yes!

And with Nice Nature's guidance,
we had fun playing menko.

With its simple yet strategic depth,
before we knew it, everyone was completely absorbed.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh.
The Menko cards are overlapping and I can't pick them up!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, there's a little trick to it~
If you aim for the gap like this—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Nature-chan, amazing!
You flipped it all in one go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well now,
this turned into quite a bigger crowd than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Still, something like this every once in a while
might not be so bad after all.

For a while after that,
menko became a huge craze among the students.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?
That sounds exhausting, so I'll pass—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That's it---!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the gym, both of you☆
We'll invite everyone and play tag★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, stop pulling me!
I told you, I'm passing on thissss...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha☆
One more time, one more tiiime★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, hold on, hold on!
You're still going~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪
Maya hasn't had anywhere near enough fun yet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose this time!
I'll run all the way to the end with my Pegasus Mach Strike!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh……
Does none of you ever get tired?!
choice_data_list: I'm about at my limit too...
I'm about at my limit too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Figures.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Quick question here... could we maybe just make a tactical retreat?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the young folks to it, then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aah!
Nature and the others are trying to run away~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Guess that means a game of campus tag is next☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait~☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!?
Nobody said anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wait, waiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: G-Gimme a break--!!

She kept chasing me after that and left me totally
exhausted, but it seemed to make for great
training for Nice Nature.
